name: After § 7
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: 7a. Calls for the urgent establishment of military deconfliction and crisis communication channels in the Black Sea, involving all coastal states, including through the existing mechanisms of the Montreux Convention and with the mediation of the UN, to prevent incidents from escalating;
